title: Halo Dental press & news list
description: Editorial press feed on warm stone paper: a 64px heading paired with an outline CTA at the top, followed by hairline-bordered 12-column article rows (3-col rounded thumbnail card, 3-col headline at column 6, 3-col abstract at column 9, and an outward arrow button at column 12) with a faded fourth row and a centred 'View more' button.
notes: Pass a custom media ReactNode per item to replace the default studio or press-card placeholder
When fadeLast is true (default), the final row fades behind a gradient veil with the 'View more' outline button
